Mechanical Design Engineer
About us
We build agricultural machinery for export markets.
Responsibilities
Design welded frames and gearbox housings in SolidWorks.
Prepare drawings according to ISO standards.
Requirements
Degree in mechanical engineering.
3+ years of experience in mechanical design.
English at B2 level or higher.
Nice to have
Experience with FEA (ANSYS).
We offer
Relocation package and remote Fridays.
